about: Residents' letters (Docs/Design/55-letters-gifts-favours.md, 5): the rules decide who writes, why, and what comes with it; these are the words, by kind and by how warmly the resident feels (warm: liking 70 or more; plain: 40 or more; brief: a resident who trusts more than it likes). Blanks: {to} the player as the resident knows them; {deed} what they did; {gift} the gift's line or nothing; {from} the signature; {place} where a letter goes; {reward} the pennies; {days} how long it is held for them; invitations (wedding, funeral): {when} {place} {couple} {deceased}. The light model may only polish them (Options::letterModelCallsPerHour), keeping every name, number and place.
gift: I've put {gift} in with this. It isn't much.
There's {gift} with this, for your trouble.
